highlights.quote: Aggression is a useful word only when it is made to carry less.
highlights.judgment: The book's controlling argument stated with unusual economy; it earns the definitional taxonomy that follows.

highlights.quote: The bones establish a violent meeting; they do not identify its command.
highlights.judgment: Exemplary evidentiary discipline — the manuscript repeatedly refuses to let material remains testify beyond their reach.

highlights.quote: A crane fly rested on the handle of his trowel.
highlights.judgment: Concrete, unshowy sensory detail; the opening scenes are genuinely well observed rather than decorative.

highlights.quote: Every weapon was pointed by someone acting within a structure of permission and expectation.
highlights.judgment: The thesis applied cleanly across three incommensurable cases without flattening them — the book at its analytic best.

highlights.quote: The iron did not organise itself.
highlights.judgment: Short, hard sentence closing a long administrative chapter — the craft is real when it stays this plain.

highlights.quote: The weapon supplied force; an office selected its target.
highlights.judgment: The book's refrain, sharp on first appearance but restated in near-identical form in at least four later chapters.

highlights.quote: The hand can be similar; the world directing it is not.
highlights.judgment: An aphoristic paired-antithesis closer of the type that ends nearly every chapter; individually strong, cumulatively formulaic.

highlights.quote: A person may strike in anger. A household may raid. A state may punish. An army may wage war. A regime may organise atrocity.
highlights.judgment: Anaphoric escalating ladder — an effective device used so often at chapter ends that it becomes a tell.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Cinematic in-media-res opening scene (a named excavator/commander, a physical object, present-tense sensory detail) before the analytic body begins.
instances: The trowel struck something that was not stone.
The copper helmet came off the skull in Leonard Woolley’s hand.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Semicolon paired antithesis in which evidence is granted one claim and denied a larger one.
instances: The wound begins the inquiry; it does not settle the institution behind it.
The object’s shape narrows the possibilities; it does not name the purpose.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Chapter-closing coda built as an anaphoric tricolon or ladder of parallel short clauses.
instances: A wall required commands before it could protect. A ration required a clerk before it could feed. A boundary required a claimant before it could become a reason for war.
A person may strike in anger. A household may raid. A state may punish. An army may wage war. A regime may organise atrocity.

recurringPatterns.pattern: The book's thesis restated as a two-part object/office formula, recurring almost verbatim across widely separated chapters.
instances: The object supplied movement. An office supplied direction.
The weapon supplied force; an office selected its target.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Negation-then-correction pairing ("It did not X. It Y") used to pivot from a document to its analytic meaning.
instances: It did not cause the conquest. It shows William converting seizure into an inventory.
A cemetery is an event made visible by preservation and excavation. It is not a daily register of anger, fear, quarrels, threats, or reconciliation.

summary: This is an unusually disciplined comparative history of organised violence, argued from a single clear thesis: aggression is a family of acts whose reach is made by institutions, archives and offices rather than by an unchanging human appetite. The reasoning is its greatest strength — it consistently states what a piece of evidence can and cannot establish, distinguishes archaeological, literary and administrative record types, and refuses false symmetry between cases (Tollense, Chicago, Njáls saga; Libya and Tunisia). Prose is precise, largely free of filler, and the opening scenes of most chapters are concrete and well researched. The weakness is architectural sameness: nearly every chapter runs scene → document → paired comparison → aphoristic coda, and the thesis is re-crystallised in the same two-clause office/weapon formula so often that later chapters read as re-performances of chapter one. Pacing suffers most — paragraphs are uniformly medium-length and equally weighted, so a fifteen-chapter sweep across five millennia rarely accelerates or lingers, and engagement flags in the middle chapters (7, 9, 12) where the administrative register runs unbroken. With variation in chapter shape, pruning of the recurring refrain, and a few chapter endings that decline the epigram, this would be ready.
